results.hypothesis_statement: For MES futures, a positive best-bid versus best-ask displayed-size imbalance measured at 1-second resolution predicts a positive subsequent 1-second midquote return, while a negative imbalance predicts a negative subsequent return.

parsed.hypothesis_statement: For MES futures, a positive best-bid versus best-ask displayed-size imbalance measured at 1-second resolution predicts a positive subsequent 1-second midquote return, while a negative imbalance predicts a negative subsequent return.
parsed.hypothesis_rationale: Displayed depth imbalance can reflect temporary excess buy or sell pressure at the top of the order book; when liquidity providers and incoming order flow are asymmetric, the midquote may adjust in the direction of the imbalance before displayed liquidity replenishes or reverses.
